mapper.sql: sn, article_sn, from_status, to_status, action, operator, remark, change_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article_status_log (article_sn, from_status, to_status, action, operator, remark) VALUES (#{articleSn}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{action}, #{operator}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM article_status_log WHERE article_sn = #{articleSn} ORDER BY change_time DESC, sn DESC
